title: [A2 • Band 4.0] Bài 110: The Kakapo: New Zealand's Night Parrot
passageHtml:
PASSAGE 110 (LEVEL A2 • BAND 4.0)

The Kakapo: New Zealand's Night Parrot

Paragraph 1. The kakapo is a very strange bird from New Zealand. It is the only parrot in the world that cannot fly, and it is also the heaviest parrot on Earth. Long ago, there were no dangerous land animals in New Zealand, so the kakapo lived safely on the forest floor. It comes out only at night to eat plants. When it feels scared, it stops moving and stands still. It uses its green and brown feathers to hide among forest plants.

Paragraph 2. Kakapos also have unusual habits when they find partners. In summer, male birds meet on high hills. Each male digs a shallow bowl in the dirt and makes a loud, deep sound to call females from far away. However, kakapos breed only once every two to four years. They only lay eggs when native rimu trees produce plenty of fruit for the mother to feed her babies.

Paragraph 3. Standing completely still worked well against giant hunting birds, because eagles hunt with their eyes. However, human settlers later brought dogs, cats, and rats to New Zealand. These animals hunt by scent, not by sight. Sadly, kakapos have a strong, sweet smell like honey. Because they did not run away, cats and rats caught them easily, and the birds almost died out.

Paragraph 4. In 1977, wildlife workers found about two hundred kakapos on Stewart Island. Feral cats killed them quickly, so officers moved every living bird to three small islands between 1980 and 1992. Those islands had no cats or rats. Scientists also watch every bird with tiny radios and protect their eggs. Thanks to this hard work, the kakapo population grew from 51 birds in 1995 to over 250 today.

groups.instructions: Do the following statements agree with the information in the passage? Write TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN.

steps: Đoạn 1: "It uses its green and brown feathers to hide..."

q5.text: The kakapo weighs more than any other parrot species in the world.

steps: Đoạn 1: "...it is also the heaviest parrot on Earth."

q6.text: Kakapos lay eggs every spring without skipping any years.

steps: Đoạn 2: Chim chỉ sinh sản 2–4 năm một lần (every two to four years).

q7.text: Feral cats on Stewart Island lived peacefully alongside the kakapos.

steps: Đoạn 4: Mèo hoang giết chim rất nhanh (Feral cats killed them quickly).

q8.text: Tourists are forbidden by law from visiting the three safe islands.

steps: Đoạn 4: Chỉ nói các đảo không có mèo và chuột, không đề cập luật cấm du khách.
